compliance_notes: Product designs, formulas and supplier prices are trade secrets; check what leaves your network.
Safety-critical decisions must keep a qualified person in charge.
Employee incident reports contain personal data.
follow_up_questions: Is the data digital (system records, spreadsheets) or on paper or handwritten notes?
Does the task need live machine or sensor data, or just documents and text?
How many reports, work orders or orders per month?
Would a fixed rule or an ERP setting already do this?
